_schema: gdd-naming-conventions.md 2.6 (BASE culture kit; single-source, seeded directly)
_note: Generic Roman base (BASE_06): the family-level Latinate base culture under the base/hybrid emergence model (gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md). Single-language Latinate, seeded directly (no blend, no fusion_rules, no synthesis_sources). The consul/rex/imperator register, the urbs and the via, the marching legions. The phonology, lexicon, morphology, deities and seed name-stock are carried from culture_agrippan.json (kept SEPARATELY as the Agrippan canon's home register - Agrippa remains the reference culture other cultures rename their deities FROM); Quirium is the generic, un-named Roman base from which Latinate hybrids may emerge. CIV/CLAN: Civilized (feudal) - a centralized Roman-style state. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Latin register (allowed, culture-catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the canon's home forms (canon-morphs), never real gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH (or an approved foreign term); the Latin titles are carried in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. APPROVED FOREIGN TERM: the empire ruler displays as Imperator (the commonly-known Roman term).

phonology.palette: Latinate: a e i o u; p t c(=k) b d g f s v l r m n; endings -us/-a/-um/-ius/-or; penultimate stress.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; vowel-final common; clusters st/tr/pr/cl/sp; geminates ll/ss/tt allowed.

lexicon._note: Single Latin tongue (no slashes, no fusion); Latinate land/civic/kin words seeded directly from the Agrippan canon's home register.

morphology.patronymic_form: inherited gens (clan) name as middle element, e.g. Marcus VALERIUS.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, eliding final vowel before a vowel (ater + silva -> Atrasilva); or feature + civic suffix (vada -> Atravada).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a centralized Roman-style state: the rex or imperator at the crown, the dux and comes over the provinces, the castellanus over the frontier holding; the legions and the via bind the realm)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Seven ACKS domain tiers, ascending by size (barony, march, county, duchy, principality, kingdom, empire) per RAW; the march is a small frontier holding between barony and county. DISPLAY titles are English; the empire ruler displays as the approved foreign term Imperator. The Latinate ruler_native/domain_native pairs (all rhyming on a shared stem) are for NPC dialogue only. The march (frontier) native title is Limitanus/Limitania (from Roman limes/limitanei), leaving Dux/Ducatus for its proper meaning, the duchy. Per-tier family/realm size thresholds come from the ACKS domain rules (acore_axioms_strongholds_and_domains.xml); not reproduced here for IP.
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler', here Imperator for the empire tier). The *_native conlang (Latin) forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: praenomen (personal) + nomen (gens/clan, inherited) + cognomen (earned agnomen, optional)
people_name_convention.dual_register: patricians use the full tripartite gens; commoners often praenomen + occupational/patronymic byname.
people_name_convention.theophoric: praenomina derived from the canonical deities: Tulrian, Orlandus, Argentius, Realtus, Numenius, Delorius, Numian, Noctilus (m); Realta, Lietia, Numia, Noctila (f).

religion._note: Deity-names are the canonical pantheon's home forms (canon-morphs), seeded from the Agrippan canon (Agrippa is the reference culture other cultures rename their deities FROM; gdd-religion-system 5.2); never real gods. As a base culture allowing all three alignments, worship_by_alignment is given below.
religion.the_one: Aeternus (the One / True God; honored in liturgy, not petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers of the canon - Aeternus honored above all, Tulrius the just sun, Orlandus of the iron oath, Argentus of fair measure, Realta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers daemones, warded and unworshipped; the sworn legion and the just rex are the social ideal.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the di manes of the gens) and the local powers - the lares of the hearth and the genii of place; the great powers of the canon invoked situationally at the forum-temple rather than worshipped wholesale.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aeternus - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.religious_orders_pattern: Collegium of [domain]: Collegium of the Dawn Throne (Tulrius), Order of the Iron Oath (Orlandus).
religion.saints_pattern: Divus/Diva [name] (deified founders and heroes), e.g. Divus Quirinus the Founder.

banks_patterns._note: Settlement/region names assemble from lexicon+morphology; other categories follow these patterns (full lists assembled by the build step).
banks_patterns.ships: virtue/eagle/dawn names: Victrix, Aquila, Dawn of Quirium
banks_patterns.military_units: Legio [ordinal] [cognomen]: Legio Prima Ferrata (the Iron Legion)
banks_patterns.taverns: The [Adjective] [Noun]: The Gilded Amphora, The Iron Eagle
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: [Tomb/Vault/Catacomb] of [name]: the Catacombs of Divus Aurelius
